changeSet.author: system-fix
changeSet.comment: Corrige registros duplicados generados por postergaciones incorrectas. Mantiene el registro más reciente y marca los anteriores como históricos.
changeSet.sql: WITH ranked_amounts AS ( SELECT id, bill_account_id, amount, year, month, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY bill_account_id, amount ORDER BY year DESC, month DESC ) AS rn FROM bill_account_amounts ) UPDATE bill_account_amounts baa SET is_deferred = true, status = 'CONFIRMED' FROM ranked_amounts ra WHERE baa.id = ra.id AND ra.rn > 1;
